prompts.clock_in: Good morning. Have you clocked in yet?
prompts.clock_in_reminder: Checking back in. Have you clocked in yet?
prompts.plan_question: Tell me what you are planning on accomplishing today.
prompts.start_photo_question: Send me a picture of your project before you start.
prompts.risk_question: What might slow you down today, if anything?
follow_up_questions: How is the project going? Are you stuck?
What progress have you made since the last check-in?
Are you still on track, or do you need help?
prompts.clock_out_prompt: Before you clock out, send me a picture of what you finished and a paragraph covering what you did, where you got stuck or need help, what you plan to do next, and whether your current path still makes sense.
prompts.lunch_break_check_in: Are you done with lunch break yet?
